target_claims.claim: 2021 study: 14 teams, 5 firms, over two years (source: 18 months); 40% defect cut on every task (source: not for routine tasks)
Pairs need 15% more person-hours; ten-person team needs 1.5 extra developers
Extra effort never falls with experience
Lindqvist has said teams should pair on everything
Same results hold for embedded and safety-critical software
Developers happier in pairs throughout the study
Every team should mandate pair programming (C)
